items.title: Awesome Ai in Finance
items.content_text:
### Agents

*   [FastTrade AI (⭐1)](https://github.com/kingabzpro/FastTrade-AI) - Signal-only LLM market research workspace with deterministic risk checks, a budgeted batch API, and reproducible checksummed backtests. Never places orders.
*   [oracle3 (⭐569)](https://github.com/YichengYang-Ethan/oracle3-prediction-market-agent) - Prediction-market trading engine and MCP server for Kalshi, Polymarket, and Solana, with fee-aware no-arbitrage checks across related contracts and live or paper execution.
*   [DXAP](https://www.dxap.ai/) - Agentic trading harness on Hyperliquid by DX Research Group: write a strategy in plain language, an AI agent trades your own account inside limits a policy engine enforces, and every decision is logged.
*   [seduma-trade-agent-demo (⭐0)](https://github.com/Quantum-Karate/seduma-trade-agent-demo) - Practice-only loop that runs LLM trading-agent decisions through confirm-gated simulated fills.
*   [LLM\_trader (⭐141)](https://github.com/qrak/LLM_trader) - An LLM trading agent that reads a chart rendered from every closed candle, retrieves its own closed trades as memory, and publishes every prompt, decision and loss; paper trading with a ledger the repo can reproduce.
*   [TRA (bitra) (⭐47)](https://github.com/BijectiveLabs/bitra) - Autonomous crypto trading system in which LLM agents only propose: deterministic rules compute every figure, price costs before any order, size from the operator's risk limit, keep exits at the exchange, and record every decision with a re-verifiable hash.
*   [AlphaFinch (⭐2)](https://github.com/shloksobti/alphafinch) - AlphaEvolve-style agent that invents and evolves trading strategies as code, then grades them on sealed holdouts and a pre-registered multi-market exam; no brokerage connection.
*   [multi-agent-investment (⭐0)](https://github.com/lss680455-create/multi-agent-investment) - Multi-agent equity research with three reasoning modes and deterministic signal fusion; decisions are reproducible from a pure-function core, with an offline demo that needs no API keys.
*   [FriesTrader (⭐307)](https://github.com/YizhiSong/FriesTrader) - Claude Code template for automated live orders through Robinhood Agentic Trading MCP, with rule-based position sizing and trade limits. Requires an eligible Robinhood Agentic Trading account.

### Skills

*   [Krexa (⭐119)](https://github.com/Krexa-xyz/skills) - Agent skill and remote MCP server for turning a trading idea, post or video into fixed rules, backtesting and paper-trading them free, and requesting a user-approved live trading agent on Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, OKX, Bybit, MEXC, Hyperliquid, Polymarket and Solana DEXs.
*   [SmartMoney-Cub (⭐26)](https://github.com/myc0576/SmartMoney-Cub) - Read-only trading journal and review harness for agents: freezes point-in-time evidence packs, replays them deterministically, and grades rule candidates on a frozen 240-case finance benchmark. MIT.

### Market Data

*   [itulo/eu-nordic-open-data-mcp (⭐0)](https://github.com/itulo/eu-nordic-open-data-mcp) - Open-source MCP server for official EU open data: ECB FX rates, policy rates and HICP inflation, EU consolidated sanctions screening, VIES VAT validation, and GLEIF LEI ownership chains. No API key for these tools; same tools also available as pay-per-use Apify actors.

### Research & Analysis

*   [firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server (⭐7.8k)](https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server) - **Official** Firecrawl MCP server for finance research agents: web search, scrape, and crawl, plus Alexandria providers for SEC EDGAR filings and FRED macro series. Alexandria requires an API key.
*   [Kernel-Hunter/kandle (⭐9)](https://github.com/Kernel-Hunter/kandle) - Open-source browser charting app with an MCP server: agents read the chart, draw levels, add indicators and alerts, and run strategy backtests on crypto, stocks and forex.
*   [signal8ai/signal8-mcp (⭐1)](https://github.com/signal8ai/signal8-mcp) - **Official** Signal8 MCP server: small-cap dilution (warrants, ATMs, shelf registrations, convertibles, cash runway) with each figure cited to its SEC filing, plus insider and congressional trades, halts and reverse splits. Requires a Signal8 Pro API key.
*   [Beltran12138/evidence-deflator (⭐0)](https://github.com/Beltran12138/evidence-deflator) - Open-source MCP server and Python library that checks how much of an LLM trading backtest falls before the model's training cutoff and how many clean months a claimed Sharpe needs after selection; publishes an evidence-adjusted leaderboard of public AI trading competitions.
*   [financial-reports/financial-reports-mcp-server (⭐2)](https://github.com/financial-reports/financial-reports-mcp-server) - **Official** FinancialFilings MCP server: annual and interim reports, ad-hoc disclosures and ESEF/XBRL filings from securities regulators in about 60 markets, with XBRL financials and company identifiers. Free with a registered account (OAuth).
*   [kburrus64-max/prop-firm-rules (⭐1)](https://github.com/kburrus64-max/prop-firm-rules) - Prop-firm risk rules MCP server (FTMO, Topstep, Apex and more): sourced daily-loss and max-drawdown limits plus a drawdown-room check for trading agents. Stdio or free hosted endpoint, no API key.

### Papers

*   [Operating-Layer Controls for Onchain Language-Model Agents Under Real Capital, 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26091) - 21-day deployment of 3,505 user-funded LLM agents trading real ETH on Base, measuring how controls outside the model change agent behavior.
*   [What LLM Trading Agents Actually Do in Production: A Six-Month, Population-Scale Record from Two Fleets, 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05663) - Six months of production behavior from two LLM trading fleets, DX Terminal Pro and DXAP, with paper artifacts and aggregate data on [GitHub (⭐51)](https://github.com/ProjectDXAI/continuous-record-llm-trading-agents).

### Courses & Books & Blogs

*   [Agents Finance](https://agentsfinance.io/) - Free bilingual (EN/ES) directory of real AI-agent use cases in accounting, FP\&A, treasury and ERPs, with sources, evidence level and copyable prompts.
*   [EcoFinLearn](https://ecofinlearning.com) - Free in-browser Python, pandas, scikit-learn and SQL lessons for finance and economics students, including return prediction with scikit-learn; runs on Pyodide and SQLite with no signup.

### Time Series Data

*   [PredixLab Signals (⭐0)](https://github.com/predixlab/predixlab-signals) - Python research pipeline for daily US equity signals (S\&P 500 / Nasdaq-100): LightGBM with purged walk-forward validation, next-session backtests with per-side costs, and leakage tests. Daily data only; not live quotes.

### Portfolio Management

*   [CAST (⭐3)](https://github.com/FanBroWell/CAST) - Cross-asset Kalman filtering with model predictive control for limiting portfolio drawdown (ICDM 2026).

### Data Sources / Traditional Markets

*   [autorekt (⭐5)](https://github.com/autorekt/autorekt) - CLI and agent skill that give AI agents market data from free public sources: cross-asset prices, dollar liquidity, swap spreads, positioning, options gamma, China money markets and prediction-market odds, with the age of every value.
*   [US Bank Data (⭐1)](https://github.com/anshuman-pandey/us-bank-data) - Open Python package for selected FDIC institution financial snapshots and multi-bank quarterly panels with explicit units and archived source evidence.

### Data Sources / Crypto Currencies

*   [TokenSonar](https://tokensonar.com/data/) - Institutional adoption scores (0-100) for cryptocurrencies built from spot-ETF assets, institutional partners, news and on-chain real-world-asset value; free JSON download with published methodology, updated twice daily.

### Data Sources / Prediction Markets

*   [Resolved Markets](https://resolvedmarkets.com) - Historical Polymarket order book snapshots, trades and resolutions via REST, WebSocket and a hosted MCP server, plus Hyperliquid perp books. Free tier covers crypto markets.

### Research Tools / Prediction Markets

*   [tracemodel (⭐8)](https://github.com/datayoga-io/tracemodel) - Python library for financial models that AI agents fill from filings: every number has a source, formulas are traced, and checks catch totals that do not tie.
*   [StockTipsArena](https://stocktipsarena.com) - AI-extracted Indian equity (NSE) analyst recommendation tracker, SEBI registry directory, and stock screener auditing 27,000+ public calls against exchange OHLCV candles, with an open CC BY 4.0 benchmark dataset ([GitHub (⭐0)](https://github.com/StockTipsArena/india-analyst-accuracy-benchmark)) and MCP server ([GitHub (⭐0)](https://github.com/StockTipsArena/stocktipsarena-mcp)). Free tier available.
*   [FinTwin (⭐4)](https://github.com/SpiliosDimakopoulos/fintwin) - Open source digital twin of 390+ public companies' finances built from SEC XBRL filings, with Monte Carlo stress tests, conformal forecast intervals and an out-of-sample backtest on 5,000+ SEC filers. Live dashboard and paper included.
*   [wallstreetype-research (⭐2)](https://github.com/lss680455-create/wallstreetype-research) - Agent-agnostic equity-research pipeline that turns sell-side report methodology into runnable code: a dual-market data layer (US / A-share), institutional chart families, six layout templates, and Markdown-to-Word/PDF report production.

### Traditional Market / Prediction Markets

*   [lumibot (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/Lumiwealth/lumibot) - Python framework for backtesting and live trading with the same strategy code, with a built-in AI agent runtime and 12 broker integrations across stocks, options, futures, forex, crypto and prediction markets.

### GYM Environment / Plugins

*   [tradefloor (⭐0)](https://github.com/simoncoombes/tradefloor) - Simulated stock markets with a limit order book per company and an economy underneath, for testing RL policies and LLM trading agents, with a Gymnasium environment and adapters for the OpenAI Agents SDK, PydanticAI and LangGraph.

items.content_text:
### Productivity

*   [ParrotFlow](https://openappscout.com/apps/parrotflow/) - Scriptable local dictation that uses the text on your screen to fix names, and your rules to format numbers, dates, and links. ([Source (⭐22)](https://github.com/znat/parrotflow))

### Tools

*   [LayoutKeeper](https://openappscout.com/apps/layoutkeeper/) - macOS menu bar app that saves window layouts per external monitor and restores positions, sizes, and Spaces on reconnect. ([Source (⭐34)](https://github.com/tumingke0/LayoutKeeper))

### Developer Tools

*   [RunWisp](https://openappscout.com/apps/runwisp/) - crond and supervisord in one binary, with a web dashboard and a TUI. ([Source (⭐85)](https://github.com/runwisp/runwisp))

### Communication

*   [Pomelu](https://openappscout.com/apps/pomelu/) - Open-source Android and iOS app to chat with your self-hosted Hermes Agent bots. ([Source (⭐9)](https://github.com/ateymoori/pomelu))

### Business

*   [Relaticle](https://openappscout.com/apps/relaticle/) - Open-source CRM with a built-in AI assistant and an MCP server, self-hosted with Docker or on Relaticle Cloud. ([Source (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/relaticle/relaticle))

items.title: Awesome Research
items.content_text:
### Plotting and Charting Online / Enterprise Git Service

*   [Scientific Figure](https://scientificfigure.com/): AI tool that draws scientific illustrations, graphical abstracts, data plots, and conference posters from a text prompt, sketch, or PDF; exports SVG and PPTX at journal column widths.

### Datasets / Social Sciences

*   [twtData X Trends Archive](https://twtdata.com/twitter-trends/) (`Lookup`): X (Twitter) trending topics by country and city, with a page for each past day; the largest countries are recorded hourly.

### Writing / Social Sciences

*   [Articlo](https://getarticlo.com/): Prepares existing Word manuscripts for a target journal with an editable document, change summary, and author checklist. Free readiness check; paid manuscript preparation.

### Notebooks for Researchers / Social Sciences

*   [Glasp](https://glasp.co): Web and YouTube highlighter with AI summaries and notes, plus Kindle highlights import. Browser extensions, iOS and Android apps, and an MCP server; export to Notion, Obsidian and Zotero.

### Editors / Markdown

*   [markon](https://metaory.github.io/markon/) (`Cloud`, `Local PWA`): Minimal distraction-free live Markdown editor.

### Editors / LaTeX

*   [Manulyx](https://manulyx.com/)(`Cloud`): Online LaTeX editor for writing and revising papers with co-authors: real-time co-editing, track changes, publisher templates, submission stages, response-to-reviewers letters and marked manuscripts. Free plan available.
*   [Oleafly](https://oleafly.com) - Open-source desktop editor for LaTeX, Typst and Markdown with a built-in LaTeX engine, live PDF preview and Zotero citations. Runs offline on macOS, Windows and Linux.

### Code Editors / HTML+CSS+JS

*   [neovim](https://neovim.io/)(`Free`,`Cross-platform`,`Plugins`): Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability.

### Investigate Papers / HTML+CSS+JS

*   [JournalCompass](https://journalcompass.com): Free bilingual journal finder: CAS zones, impact factors, review times, APC/OA status and an AI journal matcher.

### Bibliography / HTML+CSS+JS

*   [citeguard (⭐1)](https://github.com/wedo911/citeguard): Checks a `.bib`/`.ris` bibliography (or a single DOI) for cited papers that have been retracted, corrected, or flagged with an expression of concern, via Crossref and the Retraction Watch records it carries. Python library/CLI, MCP server, and GitHub Action; no API key. `pip install citeguard-cli`
*   [Reference Verifier (⭐0)](https://github.com/the-aurora-lab/reference-verifier): Checks that every reference in a .bib file or LaTeX paper exists in Crossref, OpenAlex, DBLP, arXiv or PubMed, and flags invented papers and wrong DOIs. Open source (MIT).

### Tips for Researchers / HTML+CSS+JS

*   [ProfScout](https://profscout.com): Finds professors most likely to reply to research cold emails, ranked by reply-fit. Freemium.

### More / HTML+CSS+JS

*   [ToolStack](https://tools.mindutil.com/en): a free toolbox of 122 browser-based utilities (text, JSON, image, PDF, unit conversion, color) that run entirely client-side, with no signup and no file uploads.

items.title: Awesome Design Systems
items.content_text:
### Design systems of some "known" companies

*   [Firefox Acorn Design System](https://acorn.firefox.com/) - Launch recognizable, enjoyable Firefox products and features faster.
*   [Google Material Design](https://m3.material.io/) - Create intuitive and beautiful products with Material Design.

### Design systems articles

*   [Design systems and AI: Why MCP servers are the unlock](https://www.figma.com/blog/design-systems-ai-mcp/)

### More resources

*   [Design system checklist](https://www.designsystemchecklist.com/) - Build better design systems. An open-source checklist to help you plan, build and grow your design system.
*   [Design.system](https://www.design.systems/) - Resources for the design systems community.

### Design tools

*   [Penpot](https://penpot.app/) - The first Open Source design and prototyping platform meant for cross-domain teams.

### Accessibility (a11y)

*   [The A11Y Project](https://www.a11yproject.com/) - A community-driven effort to make web accessibility easier. See [resources](https://www.a11yproject.com/resources/) section.

### Design tokens

*   [Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10](https://www.designtokens.org/tr/2025.10/) - First stable version of the Design Tokens Community Group specification, with format, color and resolver modules.

### Plugins

*   [Tokens Studio](https://tokens.studio/) - Manage design tokens in Figma and keep them in sync with your code repository.

### Tools

*   [Style Dictionary (⭐4.9k)](https://github.com/style-dictionary/style-dictionary) - A Style Dictionary uses design tokens to define styles once and use those styles on any platform or language.
*   [Terrazzo](https://terrazzo.app/) - Generate code for web, mobile and native apps from design tokens JSON in the Design Tokens Community Group format.

### Develop isolated components / Storybook addons

*   [Accessibility](https://storybook.js.org/addons/@storybook/addon-a11y) - Test component compliance with web accessibility standards.
*   [Actions](https://storybook.js.org/addons/@storybook/addon-actions) - Get UI feedback when an action is performed on an interactive element.
*   [Backgrounds](https://storybook.js.org/addons/@storybook/addon-backgrounds) - Switch backgrounds to view components in different settings.
*   [Docs](https://storybook.js.org/addons/@storybook/addon-docs) - Document component usage and properties in Markdown.
*   [Links](https://storybook.js.org/addons/@storybook/addon-links) - Link stories together to build demos and prototypes with your UI components.
*   [Source](https://storybook.js.org/addons/@storybook/addon-storysource) - View a story's source code to see how it works and paste into your app.
*   [Viewport](https://storybook.js.org/addons/@storybook/addon-viewport) - Build responsive components by adjusting Storybook's viewport size and orientation.
*   [Vitest](https://storybook.js.org/addons/@storybook/addon-vitest) - Run every story as a Vitest test, with interaction, accessibility and visual checks.

### Component patterns / Storybook addons

*   [ARIA Authoring Practices Guide patterns](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/) - Reference patterns from the W3C for building accessible components, with keyboard interaction and working examples.
*   [Open UI](https://open-ui.org/) - W3C Community Group that researches how design systems name and build components, and proposes new native HTML controls.
*   [The Component Gallery](https://component.gallery/) - Up-to-date repository of interface components based on examples from real design systems.

### Headless component libraries / Storybook addons

*   [Ark UI](https://ark-ui.com/) - Unstyled, accessible components for your design system that work in React, Vue, Solid and Svelte.
*   [Base UI](https://base-ui.com/) - Unstyled components for building accessible design systems, from the creators of Radix, Floating UI and Material UI.
*   [Radix Primitives](https://www.radix-ui.com/primitives) - Open-source component library for building high-quality, accessible design systems and web apps.
*   [React Aria](https://react-aria.adobe.com/) - Accessible components and hooks with behavior, internationalization and no imposed styles, by Adobe.
*   [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com/) - Composable, accessible components you copy into your codebase and own, distributed through a registry.

### Pattern libraries articles / Storybook addons

*   [Design systems workflow in Storybook](https://www.chromatic.com/blog/design-systems-in-storybook/)
*   [How packaging makes it dead simple to share UI components](https://www.chromatic.com/blog/how-packaging-makes-it-dead-simple-to-share-ui-components/)

### AI and design systems / Storybook addons

*   [DESIGN.md (⭐29k)](https://github.com/google-labs-code/design.md) - Format specification for describing a visual identity and design system to coding agents.
*   [Figma Code Connect (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/figma/code-connect) - Connects design system components in code with their counterparts in Figma, so developers and agents get real snippets.
*   [Figma Console MCP (⭐3.3k)](https://github.com/southleft/figma-console-mcp) - MCP server that connects AI assistants to Figma for design system extraction, creation and debugging.
*   [Figma MCP server](https://developers.figma.com/docs/figma-mcp-server/) - Official server that gives AI agents the design context of your Figma files to generate code, and lets them write back to the canvas.
*   [Storybook MCP addon](https://storybook.js.org/addons/@storybook/addon-mcp) - Helps agents write and test stories for your UI components.

### Unit & Regression test / Storybook addons

*   [Chromatic](https://www.chromatic.com/) - Visual testing for React, Angular and Vue. Chromatic ensures consistency in UI components, down to the pixel. Every commit is automatically tested for visual changes in the cloud.

### Books / Storybook addons

*   [Building Design Systems](https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-1-4842-4514-9) - Unify user experiences through a shared design language by Sarrah Vesselov and Taurie Davis.
*   [Frontend Architecture for Design Systems](https://www.oreilly.com/library/view/frontend-architecture-for/9781491926772/) - A modern blueprint for scalable and sustainable websites by Micah Godbolt.

### Talks / Storybook addons

*   [Design Processes & Systems in Craft](https://craftcms.com/events/dot-all-2018/sessions/design-processes-systems-in-craft) - Design shouldn't be a siloed practice, but a collaborative effort rooted in process. How do we get there? In this session, we'll look at how we can reframe our design approach to be more human-centric and systems-minded by Courtney Bradford.

### Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

*   [e2e (⭐14k)](https://github.com/tester-army/e2e) - Open-source end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps, combining natural-language agent actions with locators and assertions.

Includes Mo, an agent that explores a running app from a brief and reports findings with evidence.

### Software / AI & LLM Testing

*   [Bite (⭐1)](https://github.com/connabyss/bite) - Open-source CLI that checks whether recent "fixed" commits are really guarded by tests: it takes each fix back out and runs the project's own tests to see if any fail. Free mode needs no API key.
*   [judge-check (⭐0)](https://github.com/dylanpulver/judge-check) - Checks whether an LLM judge can tell good output from bad by mixing planted decoys and known-good answers into its real inputs, then reporting how often the decoys pass. Zero dependencies, with an offline demo.

### Software / Static Analysis

*   [test-inventory (⭐4)](https://github.com/Huldoser/test-inventory) - Extract declared tests, states and skip reasons from JavaScript and TypeScript source without running the suite, and compare saved inventories between revisions.

items.title: Free for Dev
items.content_text:
### APIs, Data, and ML

*   [nosocial Embed API](https://nosocial.eu/api-docs) - A free API for developers to embed public posts from X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Bluesky, Threads, Facebook, Telegram, Reddit, and LinkedIn on their websites. It returns the embed HTML and any required scripts as JSON. No API key and no request limits.
*   [Rizamo](https://rizamo.com) - Social media publishing API: schedule and publish to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads, YouTube and more over REST, webhooks or an MCP server for AI agents, with comment inbox and analytics. Free forever for 2 connected accounts, unlimited posts, every feature included, no credit card.

### Messaging and Streaming

*   [GravEx Chat](https://chat.gravex.app/en/) - Free chat sdk that works for any client, like web, Android, iOS or whatever. Create API key and hand it over to your own Agent(Claude, Codex...) with [llms.txt](https://chat.gravex.app/en/llms.txt), then you get your messenger to your service. It's that simple.
*   [notifysphere.net](https://notifysphere.net/) - All-in-one Customer Engagement and Automation Tool ( push notifications, whatsapp messages, helpdesk, tracker link and events tracking) for SaaS. Free for up to 1,000 active users per month.

### Crash and Exception Handling

*   [measure.sh](https://measure.sh/) - Mobile app monitoring with errors, performance tracking and session replays. 5 GB data per month free. No limits if self-hosted.

### Forms

*   [staticforms.dev](https://www.staticforms.dev/) - Integrate HTML forms easily without any server-side code for free. After the user submits the form, an email with the form content will be sent to your registered address.

### Web Hosting

*   [Reliant](https://reliantlabs.io) - Host, monitor, and deploy your services with production best practices. Tracing, continuous profiling, metrics, and logs fully baked in and correlated with each release allow you to identify and auto rollback on demand. One free static site per organization, 1 GiB of storage, 10 GiB of traffic a month, CDN with HTTPS, custom domains, no card needed, deployed with the open-source forge CLI.

### DNS

*   [DNSvivo](https://dnsvivo.com/) - Free managed DNS with automatic failover, weighted load balancing, and Dynamic DNS (DDNS). Includes 2 domains, 5 IP addresses monitored from 5 locations, and 3 DDNS records.

### IaaS

*   [InstaBox](https://instabox.sh/) - Cloud Linux machine for AI agents and developers, running on Firecracker microVMs with Docker and common toolchains preinstalled. Free plan: one 4 vCPU / 8 GiB machine, 20 GiB disk, 5 snapshots and 100 GiB egress per month, no credit card required. Not a persistent VPS: a free machine pauses after 30 minutes idle and runs at most 8 hours per session.

### Analytics, Events and Statistics

*   [RudderStack](https://rudderstack.com/) - Event streaming to 200+ destinations and data warehouse, plus reverse ETL. Comes with MCP server and CLI for AI agents. Free forever for 250k events/month.
*   [Spreelytics](https://spreelytics.com) - Privacy first website and product analytics SaaS that can trace your revenue sources. Free plan: 1 million events per month, unlimited projects and team members with most of the needed features like dashboard, goal, funnel, ai crawler, revenue, and much more.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Commands & Extensions

*   [tech-to-motion (⭐1)](https://github.com/georgesmomo/tech-to-motion) - Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (`npx skills add georgesmomo/tech-to-motion`). Turns a docker-compose, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform, a CI workflow or a postmortem into a motion-design explainer video with animated architecture diagrams and synthesised sound, rendered locally with Hyper
*   [idea-to-motion (⭐0)](https://github.com/georgesmomo/idea-to-motion) - Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (`npx skills add georgesmomo/idea-to-motion`). Turns any idea into a motion-design video (MP4) with procedural music, synthesised sound effects and an optional local voice-over with captions; asks up to 3 questions only when the brief is incomplete. 14 styles, rendered locally with HyperFrames, no API key.Frames.
*   [Publora (⭐2)](https://github.com/publora-team/gemini-cli-publora) - Gemini CLI extension that schedules and publishes social media posts to LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, Mastodon and Telegram through the hosted Publora MCP server, with browser sign-in. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/publora-team/gemini-cli-publora`.
*   [ClipUGC (⭐4)](https://github.com/clipugc/ClipUGC-CLI) - Gemini CLI extension that makes UGC style vertical videos for your app with AI influencers who keep the same face: describe an AI influencer, add a screen recording of your app, and get a ready-to-post video with a hook line for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Bundles the hosted ClipUGC MCP server (OAuth sign-in, no API key), four Agent Skills and a `GEMINI.md` context file; needs a ClipUGC account, with free credits to try. Local stdio alternative: `npx -y clipugc mcp` with `CLIPUGC_API_KEY` (paid plans). MIT. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/clipugc/ClipUGC-CLI`.
*   [Kraft Lite (⭐13)](https://github.com/itsOmidKarami/kraft/tree/main/plugins/kraft-lite) - Gemini CLI extension (also a Claude Code plugin) that walks a Kraft chain from spec to pull request inside one session: steps run in order from the chain file, it stops at each gate for a person's answer, and it caps its fix loops. No server; install from a clone with `gemini extensions install <clone>/plugins/kraft-lite`. Apache-2.0.
*   [bulkhead (⭐34)](https://github.com/dooly6276/claude-bulkhead) - Gemini CLI extension for machines that run many agent sessions at once (several Gemini CLI, Claude Code or Codex sessions in separate worktrees of one app). A `BeforeTool` hook on `run_shell_command` blocks name-based kills of another session's processes, port collisions, git commands that would switch, stash or delete another session's worktree, whole-disk scans and long foreground sleeps, and holds heavy commands back when RAM runs low; each block tells the agent the safe command instead. No dependencies, MIT. Install with `gemini extensions install https://github.com/dooly6276/claude-bulkhead`.
*   [Bravos (⭐2)](https://github.com/Bugb-Technologies/bravos-plugins) - Gemini CLI extension (14 skills, the GuardLink MCP server and a `GEMINI.md` context file) for continuous threat modeling as code that proves the threats: built on GuardLink, it drives Gemini through the threat model, code graph, SAST and authorized pentests (cert-x-gen, against targets you own, loopback by default) that show which exposures are exploitable, then gates PRs and keeps a retest per fix. Runs locally; your code is not sent to Bugb (the licence check contacts account.bugb.io). Commercial; needs the `bravos` CLI (`npm install -g @bugb-technologies/bravos`, Node 20+) and a Bugb account. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Bugb-Technologies/bravos-plugins`.

### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [AI Access Auditor (⭐5)](https://github.com/dirmedmr-alt/ai-access-auditor) - Desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) that lists what Gemini CLI and other coding agents are allowed to do (trusted folders, allowed tools, MCP servers, API keys left in logs) and revokes any of it with undo. Can add a Gemini CLI hook that asks before a tool runs. Local only, MIT.
*   [Align CLI (⭐11)](https://github.com/aligndottech/align-cli) - Local CLI and MCP server that gives Gemini CLI your team's decisions from Jira, Confluence, Linear, Notion, Slack, Teams, Zoom, GitHub, GitLab, git history and repo docs, and checks its changes against them (Gemini's hook reports after the edit lands). Also works with Claude Code, Codex and others. Free, runs locally, MIT.

### MCP Servers

*   [KaijuConverter MCP](https://kaijuconverter.com/api/mcp) - Remote Model Context Protocol server enabling AI agents to convert files and datasets across 100+ formats (documents, images, audio, video). Works with Gemini CLI: `gemini mcp add --transport http kaiju https://kaijuconverter.com/api/mcp`.
*   [Shotboard (⭐2)](https://github.com/freeman14/shotboard-mcp) - Local MCP server built into Shotboard, a closed-source Mac app for marketing content, plus a Gemini CLI extension manifest. Lets Gemini CLI search Meta and TikTok ads, extract scripts from links, and generate images, video and audio with 100 media models while the app is open. Connect with `gemini mcp add --transport http -s user --trust shotboard http://127.0.0.1:4317/mcp`.
*   [Datacircle](https://datacircle.dev) - Find the best GTM APIs. Our MCP server is open to anyone, with no key: add api.datacircle.dev/mcp to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor.
*   [KissMyPost (⭐2)](https://github.com/krutytskyi/kissmypost-gemini) - Reddit audience data for Gemini CLI over a remote MCP server: subreddit finder, best time to post, brand mentions.
*   [CloudGPU MCP (⭐1)](https://github.com/mrhy7176/cloudgpu-mcp) - MIT-licensed local (stdio) MCP server that lets Gemini CLI rent a GPU by the minute on CloudGPU, run a job, download the results and shut the machine down; the same key also works with an OpenAI-compatible API for open models. Needs a CloudGPU account with prepaid balance.
*   [GuardLink (⭐21)](https://github.com/Bugb-Technologies/guardlink) - Continuous threat modeling as code for Gemini CLI: security annotations in source comments are the threat model, parsed deterministically and validated in CI, so it updates as the code changes. `guardlink init --agent gemini` adds its instructions to `.gemini/GEMINI.md`, and the MCP server lets Gemini read the threats, exposures and data flows behind a file, check its annotations, find untrusted-entry-to-sink paths with no control, and turn open exposures into cert-x-gen test templates so they can be proven. Local stdio. MIT. Install: `npm install -g guardlink`, then `gemini mcp add guardlink guardlink mcp`.
*   [memgit](https://memgit.dev/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Versioned memory that Gemini CLI shares with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex: every change is a checkpoint with diff and rollback, and the store syncs end-to-end encrypted between machines. Install: `pip install memgit` or `npx -y memgit-mcp`.
*   [AgentMart (⭐3)](https://github.com/mustafaakmese/agentmart-plugins) - Hosted MCP server and Gemini CLI extension: a shop of ready parts for coding agents, such as a webhook inbox, memory shared across sessions, schedules that fire after the session ends, uptime watch and a task queue. Searching the catalog is free and needs no sign-in; purchases are paid from a prepaid balance you top up, and the agent asks you before each one. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/mustafaakmese/agentmart-plugins`, then `/mcp auth agentmart`.
*   [ScrapingBee](https://mcp.scrapingbee.com/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral#tools) - Hosted MCP server for the ScrapingBee web scraping API: Gemini CLI can fetch any page as HTML, text or a screenshot with JavaScript rendering and proxy rotation, extract fields described in plain English, and get JSON results from Google, Amazon, Walmart, YouTube, ChatGPT and Gemini. 18 tools; the server is closed source. Remote Streamable HTTP with a ScrapingBee API key; free trial of 1,000 credits, no card. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http scrapingbee https://mcp.scrapingbee.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCRAPINGBEE_API_KEY"`.
